messages:
jess: Quick check — planning to flip runtime.speculative_decode to 10% for the text-serving fleet tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Target models: rwd-small-*, rwd-medium-*. Flash-attn will remain ON. KV cache TTL unchanged. Need infra + oncall signoff and clear rollback/runbook. Any objections?
kevin: +1 to canary but what exact metrics should gate the rollout? propose: p99 latency, 5xx error rate, memory OOMs, and token-per-request cost delta. Also flag to exclude enterprise tenants.
oliver: One heads-up: speculative decode can alter KV cache access patterns when cache hits are low; please keep kernel-fallback toggles enabled (kernel.fallback=true) so we can force flash-attn -> generic path if needed. Also check quantized kernel interaction for rwd-small.
maya: Can we have explicit rollback commands and the audience definition? I can own oncall during the window if nobody else available.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag flip draft created -> https://internal.ops/redwood/flags/12345 (owner: jess)
infra-bot: command preview:
```
/flags flip runtime.speculative_decode=true --audience="10%:random_users" --models="rwd-small-*,rwd-medium-*" --start=2026-03-18T22:00:00Z --note="10% canary, flash-attn preserved"
```
jess: Rollback / emergency commands:
```
/flags set runtime.speculative_decode=false --audience=all --force
/flags set kernel.fallback=true --audience=all
```
jess: Canary cohorts: 10% random users + exclude tag:enterprise:true (so no enterprise workloads). Will also publish a cohort label to tracing so we can filter traces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412 (spec-decouple + metrics tags)
kevin: Alert thresholds suggestion: p95 latency increase > 5% for 10m OR p99 > 8% -> auto pause; 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute -> rollback. Also add an anomaly detector on OOMs.
oliver: Agreed. I'll validate that kernel.fallback path keeps tokens stable and won't regress perf for the control group. Will also run a quick matrix locally to check flash-attn + quant kernels on rwd-small. ETA 2 hours.
maya: I'll drive the runbook doc and monitor dashboards during the window. Adding these shortcuts to the runbook for quick rollback + who to page:
- rollback command (jess)
- infra pager (kevin)
- runtime lead (oliver)
- eng-sre rota (maya)
jess: Thanks — I'll wait for oliver greenlight and kevin final thresholds. If no objections, flip window tomorrow 22:00 UTC. I'll post a 15m heads-up in #eng-runtime before starting. :thumbsup:
kevin: Fine by me, ping me 10m before.
oliver: I'll post results of the local matrix in this thread in ~2h. If I see any mem regression I'll call for a hold.
maya: Holding schedule noted, I'll be on the pager and will watch the cohort-specific traces.
jess: Awesome — tagging infra-bot to create the canary run and the alert rules before the start. infra-bot: please create alerts for the thresholds above and attach to the flag flip.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: alerts created -> https://internal.ops/redwood/alerts/flag-1738204567 (p95/p99/5xx/ooms)
jess: All right — thanks team. Will update the PR with the final start time after oliver posts his validation.
kevin: Quick note: exclude high-cost tenants by adding audience filter: "!tag:cost_sensitive" — we should include that in the flip command.
jess: Good catch, adding it now to the deploy draft.
maya: Small precaution: keep the KV cache prefetch percentage unchanged for the canary; changing both spec-decode and kv-prefetch at once will be hard to debug.
jess: Agreed, leaving KV prefetch alone. We only tweak spec-decode for this canary.
oliver: Update: local matrix done — flash-attn+spec-decode path looks stable on rwd-medium but rwd-small shows a 2% p95 increase under a tiny batch workload. Not catastrophic but flagged. Recommend we proceed but keep a slightly tighter p95 threshold (4% instead of 5%).
jess: Ok setting p95 auto-pause to 4% then. Proceeding once infra + kevin confirm.
kevin: Confirmed. Proceed.
maya: I'll stand by oncall. Good luck folks. :rocket:
